## 4. Group sheets

* `GRP_KASHI` (P1): AMK_A, AML_A — the two Kāśī princesses side by side, front and 3/4 views, bridal and widow costume variants
* `GRP_YAJA` (P1): YAJ_A, UPY_A — the two ritual priests at a fire altar, front and 3/4
* `GRP_GANDHARVA` (P1): ANG_A, KMB_A — gandharva husband and wife beside a painted chariot
* `GRP_SVAYAMVARA_BRAHMINS` (P1): BRO_A, BRY_A — old and young brahmin in deerskins, front and 3/4
* `GRP_EKACHAKRA` (P1): EKB_A, EKW_A, EKD_A — the brahmin family of three, plus a small boy as an extra
* `GRP_UPAPANDAVA` (P2, P3): UPP_PRA, UPP_SUT, UPP_SKR, UPP_STN, UPP_SSN — Draupadī's five sons in a row, each labelled, each resembling his father
* `GRP_LOKAPALA` (P2): YAM_A, VRN_A, KUB_A — three world-guardians on mountain peaks
* `GRP_PANCHALA` (P3): UTM_A, YDM_A — two Pāñcāla wheel-guards
* `GRP_MAUSALA_SAGES` (P3): VSM_A, KNV_A — two old sages (with Nārada NRD_A)
